challenge.heading: Two moods. One place people remember.
challenge.copy: The concept moved from coffee and pastries into aperitivo and small plates, but the early identity made those moments feel like separate businesses. Juniper needed a name and voice broad enough to hold the whole day together.

contribution.heading: A flexible identity with a botanical spark.
contribution.copy: We created the Juniper name, a characterful wordmark, and a botanical system that shifts in energy across cups, menus, packaging, and evening communications while remaining unmistakably part of the same place.
